name: Ritika Sharma
quote: Sterlyn asked better questions than any architect we interviewed, and the loft still feels like us two years on.

name: Owen D'Souza
quote: They redesigned our studio around how the team actually works, not how a brochure said a studio should look.

name: Meera Kulkarni
quote: Every material choice had a reason behind it. Nothing in the house feels decorative for its own sake.
